scope: XLSX single-row loops, formula/range rewriting and bounded calculation
features: Single-row object-array loops with typed cells, rich shared strings and explicit parent scope
Empty-list row removal and multiple independent row expansions
Relative/absolute/mixed A1 references, cross-sheet dependencies and quoted sheet names
Cell-anchored pictures and merges below loops move with their rows
Fresh formula caches and obsolete calculation-chain removal

checks.productionApiSmoke: DOCX/PDF levels 20 and 61 (including empty lists), DOCX 100; XLSX/PDF levels 1, 30, 50, 61 (including empty lists) and 80; XLSX 100 through the bounded worker

independentCalculation.method: Render a separate workbook, reopen/save it as XLSX with a separate LibreOffice profile, and compare cached type/value for every formula emitted by the renderer. Ignore only extra formulas LibreOffice synthesizes for static boolean cells.
independentCalculation.ci: Production conversion job repeats this check and uploads formula-comparison.json
independentCalculation.findings: COUNT ignores direct error arguments. Boolean concatenation differs across applications and is explicitly unsupported. Nonfinite numeric literals and ambiguous zero powers are also rejected rather than assigned speculative cached values.

visual.method: Separately convert actual/reference XLSX with the pinned converter/fonts and compare all decoded RGBA pixels at 96 DPI
visual.limitations: Synthetic documents and one converter/font environment; not proof of repair-free Excel opening or general fidelity

syntax: Arithmetic, comparison and limited text concatenation

knownLimits: Without row loops, the previous scalar adapter preserves formula caches and requests recalculation on opening
Nested/multi-row loops and picture cloning inside repeated rows are not implemented
Merged ranges or frozen panes intersecting loops are rejected
Shared/array/data-table formulas, advanced functions, named operands, structured references, whole-row/column references and array-valued expressions require later adapters
Boolean concatenation and zero raised to a nonpositive power are explicitly unsupported
Charts, pivots, comments, legacy drawings and unsupported extensions in loop workbooks require adapters
Excel locale/precision equivalence, real-world Office opening and full OOXML conformance remain future gates
next: Durable jobs, tenant-scoped storage and template versions; expand real-world templates and advanced document adapters while retaining complete synthetic corpus gates
